groups.saying_opens: حرم رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم نبيذ الجر

notes: two sayings with their own transmitters: Ibn Umar's ruling on nabidh al-jarr (saying 1), and Ibn Abbas's definition of the vessel, reported to Sa'id after he went to him (saying 2); both keep the head up to Sa'id
«يعني ابن حازم» is an editor's gloss and is left out
«صدق ابن عمر» is Ibn Abbas's confirmation, a remark in the scene, not a third saying
